PROP-e5782b58-inv-011.text: Soft-deleted users (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) must be excluded from all active user queries.
PROP-e5782b58-inv-011.assertion: forall active_query on members.users: WHERE deleted_at IS NULL applied

locations.note: Duplicate check at line 248 includes .is('deleted_at', null) — soft-deleted members are correctly treated as non-existing for new registration.
Profile existence check at line 358-360 also applies .is('deleted_at', null).
Member profile query at line 78 applies .is('deleted_at', null). Soft-deleted users are gated to registration flow.
Bulk status update at lines 698-728 applies .is('deleted_at', null) to exclude soft-deleted members from academic year updates.
